description:
Nearly a million young Britons are out of education, employment or training; a growing ‘moral crisis’ that also costs the treasury billions. Tomorrow, former Labour minister Alan Milburn will publish a landmark review to tackle it, recommending a radical shake-up of sickness and disability benefits for the under-25s. But is the welfare system failing young people, or is Britain simply failing to offer them a way into work? We meet the young people behind the statistics – and Milburn himself – to find out what it will take to turn the crisis around.
